entities.name: Ponte de Vila Formosa
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Roman Bridge of Vila Formosa crosses the Seda stream, close to the village of Seda, in the municipality of Alter do Chão, in the Portalegre District of Portugal. It dates back to the first century CE.
